Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. Forwarding our proposed visitor verification flow and liaison assignments below. Attaching the visitor badge template.

Summary (short checklist you can share with facilities):
1) Pre-registration: we need attendee full name, company, DOB (optional), and one government ID type. Driver's license or passport is acceptable; passport preferred for international attendees. Please send the list 72 hours in advance for basic name screening.
2) Visitor acknowledgement: sign a short Site Conduct & Privacy acknowledgment (we'll send via DocuSign or paper on arrival).
3) Badgeing: front-desk will issue printed visitor badge with expiry at end of day; badge template attached (visitor_badge_template.pdf).
4) Escorts: our sponsor model means a Redwood sponsor will escort visitors from check-in to the meeting rooms and back to drop-off. No unescorted movement in secure areas.
5) Device policy: personal phones are allowed; company-managed laptops should be approved by your security lead in advance. For the secure demo room, we recommend no external storage devices or guest Wi-Fi access unless pre-authorized.
6) VIP drop-off & parking: use the main building drop (map to be shared). If you have a dedicated car for VIP Tom Reyes, we'll reserve the curb for 15 minutes at arrival.
7) Emergency contacts: onsite liaison Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com / +1 650-555-1122). Secondary: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com / +1 415-555-1999).

Attachments: visitor_badge_template.pdf

If you want a single doc we can sign and return (DocuSign), I can send the acknowledgement and badge manifest to you today.

Thanks,

Folks — looping in details from our security ops and ops playbook so we have a single source to share with NovaCorp. Copy/paste friendly.

- Pre-screen: For any external attendee flagged as exec-level (C-level, > title VP), security wants a phone-based verification + org chart confirmation 48 hours prior.
- Background check: NovaCorp asked about this — we can provide a basic name-only screening (no PII exchange) if they authorize it. If NovaCorp requests vendor background, we need signed consent.
- Badge rules: Badges expire at 18:00 local; lost-badge fee/lockdown procedure included in the MOB doc.
- Secure room access: No personal devices in the secure demo room unless security approves a temporary exception; we can arrange a locked staging laptop that stays in the room.
- Escort ratio: 1 sponsor per 3 visitors recommended. For VIPs, 1:1 escort.
- Parking & logistic attachments: site_parking_map.png included — please verify curb hold timing for VIP arrival.
- Paperwork: attach MOB-visitor-acknowledgement.docx for signature on arrival OR send DocuSign link in advance.

I'll prepare a one-page liaison pack (contact list, arrival script, badge image, emergency response) and drop it in our drive folder: https://redwood.example.com/drive/onsite/liaison-pack

Marissa
